experiment: Stage 2 v1 retrained with 10 fraud-statistics features (engine/fraudMath.ts); everything else unchanged

features.benford_mad: Nigrini mean absolute deviation from Benford shares
features.daily_dispersion: Var / Mean of sales per day (1 = Poisson)
features.gap_burstiness: (sigma - mu) / (sigma + mu) of inter-arrival gaps (Goh & Barabasi 2008)
features.payer_entropy: normalised Shannon entropy of sales per payer
features.payer_gini: Gini coefficient of sales per payer
features.returning_share: share of identified sales from payers seen at least twice
features.repeat_gap_cv: mean CV of each repeat payer's own gaps

verdict: Non-round deposits (unseen type) 6% -> 83%, but fragile: dropping three weak features gives 22%, so treat as promising, not proven. Perfect mimic unchanged at 0% (burstiness separates it univariately, AUC 0.87, but not after training without the type). Small side-stream 95% -> 84% (CIs overlap). In-distribution: nested-CV log loss unchanged, ECE improved 0.017 -> 0.009; single hold-out slightly worse (log loss 0.034 -> 0.041, one false alarm).
